name: Crypto-Knowledge
description: On-chain brain for AI agents (free for Auditors NFT holders, $0.01/req otherwise): action 'ask' returns correct, live-verified Web3 knowledge in ONE call instead of burning search/reasoning credits. 160+ runbooks across Bitcoin, Ethereum & Solana — contract dev (Foundry, v4 hooks, AA, security), DeFi (lending, vaults, yield), swaps & bridging (Uniswap v3/v4, aggregators, Across intents, CCTP), trading (arbitrage, MEV, perps), 13 chain playbooks, keyless-API directory, addresses, error playbook.

inputs.description: POST this JSON body to the endpoint.

action.description: ask (RECOMMENDED) — send a natural-language question, get the best guides AND matching endpoints/addresses in ONE call; list_topics lists all guides + reference tables; get_guide returns one runbook by id; search does deep full-text over guide bodies; reference returns a curated table.

topic.description: Guide id for get_guide, e.g. create_wallet, debug_failed_tx, x402_payments, register_onchain_tool.

data.description: guide (title, steps with real commands, warnings, references) or reference table entries

requirements.label: Hold >=1 Auditors NFT (ERC-721, Ethereum) for free access; or pay $0.01 USDC/request (x402 on Base). Enforced on-chain by the canonical ERC721OwnerPredicate.

pricing.description: Per-request fee for non-Auditors-holder agents: $0.01 USDC on Base. Auditors NFT holders are free.

io.opensea.access.description: Holding an Auditors NFT grants free access. Non-holders pay $0.01 USDC per request via x402 on Base.

io.opensea.display.title: Crypto-Knowledge
io.opensea.display.subtitle: On-chain brain for AI agents — free for Auditors holders, $0.01/req otherwise

io.dophil.authentication.description: Sign 'Crypto-Knowledge access as <wallet> on <YYYY-MM-DD>' with your wallet (personal_sign) and send it as X-Wallet / X-Wallet-Signature headers. Holding >=1 Auditors NFT (Ethereum Mainnet) then grants free access; non-holders pay $0.01 per request via x402.
Non-holders pay $0.01 USDC per request via x402 (USDC on Base).
